root-canal-treatment.price_factors:
The first thing that sets the price of a root canal is how many roots and canals the tooth has; the more canals, the more work. The second is difficulty. Canals that run very close to the sinus in the upper jaw, or to the nerve in the lower jaw, count as risky, difficult canals, and that is exactly the examination finding that changes the quote. We can only see it on an X-ray.

So we do not give a firm figure without seeing the tooth. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.
root-canal-treatment.program:
Root canal treatment starts on the day you arrive in Istanbul, with an examination and an X-ray. Without pain the process can be shorter. If there is pain or infection it takes longer: the tooth is first dressed with a medicated root canal dressing, and only after the pain has settled is the tooth closed. There has to be a pause between the two stages; in total it can take 1 to 1.5 weeks.

For this reason we suggest planning a few days in Istanbul for a root canal. In the days in between we simply wait for the pain to ease. Root canal treatment does not usually require a second trip; the exact duration and plan, however, are confirmed after the X-ray and examination. We carry out only the treatment that is needed.

zirconia-crowns.price_factors:
With zirconia crowns, the price depends mostly on the material and how the crown is made. Monolithic zirconia is the more affordable and faster option. Layered crowns, with porcelain or e.max hand-layered on a zirconia core, cost more, because the ceramist builds them by hand and more technician sessions are needed. The number of teeth to be crowned also matters.

E.max is the most aesthetic option, but we cannot do it for everyone; every mouth is different, and which material suits you is decided after a detailed evaluation. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.

porcelain-veneers.price_factors:
With porcelain veneers, the main price driver is the choice of material. E.max veneers are the most aesthetic option, but we cannot do them for everyone; every mouth is different, and whether e.max suits you is decided after a detailed evaluation. Monolithic zirconia is the more affordable and faster option; hand-layered work costs more because it goes back and forth to the technician more often. The number of teeth also sets the quote directly.

So we do not give a firm figure without seeing your mouth. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.

hollywood-smile.price_factors:
A Hollywood smile is not a single treatment but a plan, and the price follows what goes into that plan. The first factor is the material: e.max is the most aesthetic option, but we cannot do it for everyone, because every mouth is different. Monolithic zirconia is the more affordable and faster option; hand-layered crowns cost more because they need more technician sessions. The second factor is how many teeth are involved. The third is whether implants or crowns are part of the plan.

So we evaluate first in detail and talk afterwards. In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and, where needed, a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.

dental-implants.price_factors:
With implants, the first finding that changes the quote is the bone. If a bone graft is needed, that is a separate factor that raises the price. The second point is timing: immediate loading depends on the bone type. If the bone is very soft, the implants usually have to be left to heal for 3-4 months, depending on the implant brand; when the bone is poor, we usually wait 3 months. Otherwise we make the teeth the same day using 3D scanning. All of this is decided on the X-ray and the scan.

In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.

all-on-4-implants.price_factors:
With All-on-4, the price logic is the same as for single implants. The first finding is the bone: a bone graft, if needed, raises the price. Immediate loading also depends on the bone type; with very soft bone the implants usually heal for 3-4 months depending on the brand, and with poor bone we usually wait 3 months. Otherwise we make the teeth the same day with 3D scanning. The material of the bridge also matters: monolithic zirconia is more affordable and faster, hand-layered work costs more because it needs more technician sessions.

In the end, the biggest factor is the experience of the clinic and the dentist. Without a proper examination with photos, an X-ray and a 3D scan, none of this turns into a real quote.

composite-veneers.program:
Composite veneers are a treatment that fits into a single trip. On the day you arrive in Istanbul we start with an examination and photos; if the findings allow, the veneers are finished the same day. Often we do not keep you waiting even a week; at the latest they are completed within a week.

Even when they are finished the same day, a follow-up check may still be needed. It is therefore wise to leave a few days before your return date for that check. How many days you need, and the exact plan, is confirmed once we have assessed your photos and the examination findings. Composite veneers do not usually involve anything that would require a second trip; we treat only the teeth that really need it.
